config.question: Apply the selected criteria in context, distinguishing attribution, counter-speech, uncertainty and competing frameworks.

lens_snapshots.name: Doxa & discourse
lens_snapshots.description: Inspect expressed positions, framing, values and reviewable assumptions.
lens_snapshots.scope: Descriptive discourse analysis; implicit assumptions are hypotheses, not private beliefs.

criteria.label: Expressed stance
criteria.description: Identify a position toward a specified proposition, with the speaker and target explicit. Sentiment alone is not stance.

criteria.label: Problem framing
criteria.description: Identify how a passage defines a problem, assigns causes or responsibility, invokes a value, or proposes a remedy.

criteria.label: Presupposition hypothesis
criteria.description: Identify an assumption taken for granted by the wording. Mark it ambiguous where alternative readings exist; do not infer an author's hidden beliefs.

criteria.label: Rhetorical device
criteria.description: Describe an evidenced generalization, contrast, euphemism, moral boundary, metaphor, or appeal to authority; explain its textual function.

lens_snapshots.context_rules: Distinguish the document author from quoted or reported speakers. Absence of a viewpoint is meaningful only against a declared comparator. Do not infer religious or political identities.

lens_snapshots.name: Antisemitism · IHRA
lens_snapshots.description: Apply a context-sensitive operational summary of the IHRA working definition.
lens_snapshots.scope: Non-legally-binding framework. Findings concern passages, not whether a person is antisemitic.

criteria.label: Anti-Jewish hostility or stereotyping
criteria.description: Assess hostility, dehumanization, conspiracies, or collective allegations directed at Jews as Jews.

criteria.label: Collective responsibility
criteria.description: Assess holding Jewish people collectively responsible for real or alleged acts of another person, group, or Israel.

criteria.label: Israel-related expression in context
criteria.description: Assess relevant IHRA examples in overall context, including anti-Jewish tropes, discriminatory standards or denial of Jewish self-determination. Do not assume that policy criticism alone satisfies a criterion.

lens_snapshots.context_rules: The examples require overall context. Criticism of Israel similar to criticism of other countries is not antisemitic under the source text. Distinguish quotation, reporting, opposition to hate, criticism of a government, and endorsement. Indicate insufficient context when evidence does not establish the criterion.

lens_snapshots.name: Antisemitism · Jerusalem Declaration
lens_snapshots.description: Read passages through the Jerusalem Declaration's definition and contextual guidelines.
lens_snapshots.scope: Alternative framework with its own protections for political expression; no legal determination.

criteria.label: Discrimination against Jews as Jews
criteria.description: Assess discrimination, prejudice, hostility, or violence against Jews as Jews or Jewish institutions as Jewish.

criteria.label: Tropes and collective guilt
criteria.description: Assess anti-Jewish conspiracies, essentializing stereotypes, and responsibility assigned to Jews for Israel's conduct.

criteria.label: Political-expression boundary
criteria.description: Differentiate anti-Jewish expression from political criticism. BDS, anti-Zionism, constitutional alternatives securing equality, and disproportionate criticism are not inherently antisemitic under this framework.

lens_snapshots.context_rules: Read all relevant contextual guidelines. Political position by itself does not establish anti-Jewish prejudice. Preserve genuine ambiguity and distinguish a speaker's statements from text quoting or opposing them.

lens_snapshots.name: Antisemitism · Nexus
lens_snapshots.description: Apply the Nexus distinction between anti-Jewish prejudice and political opposition.
lens_snapshots.scope: Contextual framework; findings do not establish a person's intentions or legal liability.

criteria.label: Anti-Jewish tropes
criteria.description: Assess stereotypical assertions, conspiracies, demonization, or unequal treatment directed at Jews as Jews.

criteria.label: Collective guilt
criteria.description: Assess blaming Jews collectively for Israel or presuming Jewish individuals are agents of Israel.

criteria.label: Political-opposition boundary
criteria.description: Distinguish hostility to Jews from criticism of Israel or Zionism. Disproportionate attention to Israel is not prima facie proof of antisemitism.

lens_snapshots.context_rules: Do not classify political opposition from keywords alone. Identify the target, source speaker and supporting context. Describe systemic claims only where the supplied corpus supports them.

lens_snapshots.name: Anti-Muslim hostility · England 2026
lens_snapshots.description: A contextual reading of England's non-statutory Anti-Muslim Hostility definition.
lens_snapshots.scope: England-specific non-statutory definition. Text alone may not establish intention or unlawful discrimination.

criteria.label: Hostility toward Muslims
criteria.description: Identify evidenced threatening, abusive, or hostile expression targeting people because they are Muslim or perceived to be Muslim.

criteria.label: Stereotyping and intent
criteria.description: Assess stereotyping intended to encourage hatred of Muslims. If intent is not established by context, explicitly mark insufficient_context rather than claiming it.

criteria.label: Targeted discrimination indicators
criteria.description: Identify stated exclusion or unequal treatment directed at Muslims; do not pronounce legal unlawfulness from a passage.

lens_snapshots.context_rules: The guidance protects criticism, ridicule, and discussion of Islam. Differentiate criticism of doctrines, religious institutions or policy from hostility to people. Do not presume intent from an isolated word or a demographic label.

lens_snapshots.name: Islamophobia · structural racism
lens_snapshots.description: Inspect anti-Muslim racialization and exclusion, including evidenced institutional patterns.
lens_snapshots.scope: Structural analytical lens, distinct from the England conduct-and-intent framework.

criteria.label: Racialization and essentializing
criteria.description: Assess treating Muslims or perceived Muslims as a homogeneous, inferior, threatening, or inherently suspect population.

criteria.label: Exclusion and unequal treatment
criteria.description: Identify expressed exclusion, discriminatory expectations, or restrictions attached to Muslim identity.

criteria.label: Institutional pattern hypothesis
criteria.description: Identify an evidenced institutional practice or repeated pattern. One passage cannot by itself establish a systemic pattern; mark insufficient context when required.

lens_snapshots.context_rules: Separate critique of beliefs or institutions from racialization of people. A structural claim needs corpus context and an explicit comparator; preserve its evidential limits.
